policy_denials.detail: tail -30 crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs; grep -n "OLY-A-12" -B2 -A8 docs/spec.toml | head -40; sed -n 1,30p CHANGELOG.md; tail -30 docs/decisions.md; grep -n "SurfaceInventory" -A14 crates/athena-data/src/records/design_surface.rs | head -30

printf '%s\n' '' '## D172 · A surface change is checked against the decision log by path, in a library function not yet wired in' '' '- **Case:** OLY-A-12 (the API surface is not treated as settled) was active with no mechanism. The design-surface' '  inventory and `diff` in `crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs` already list what changed in commands, flags,' '  config keys, record schemas, roles and crates, but nothing asked whether a design decision went with the change.' '- **Decision:** `undecided_surface_changes` takes a `SurfaceDiff` and the changed paths. It returns one finding per' '  kind with changes unless `docs/decisions.md` is among the paths, and none for an empty difference. A design' '  decision means the log is touched in the same change. The check is a pure function: the caller supplies the' '  paths. It is not wired into landing, admission or `athena status`, so the OLY-A-12 measure is `status: not' '  shown` and names the test, as OLY-A-09 does.' '- **Alternatives:** Computing the inventories and paths from two commits inside the function repeats `inventory_at`' '  and `diff` and needs a git fixture per case. Parsing the new entries to require one that names the changed item' '  judges intent, which this change does not ask for. Wiring now would add a refusal and a status label, both' '  out of scope.' '- **Tradeoff:** The check tests the path, not a new heading. The log is append-only, so any change to it is an' '  append, and text appended with no new `## D<n>` heading still silences the check. A private `DECISION_LOG`' '  constant now sits in `design_surface.rs` beside the one in `crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs`; the two can' '  drift until they are merged.' '- **Reversal cost:** Low; remove the function, its test and the spec text. No record schema or config key was' '  added.' '- **Provenance:** Read: `crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs`, `crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs`,' '  `crates/athena-data/src/decision_links.rs`, the OLY-A-09 entry in the changelog, the measure-label check in' '  `crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs`. Measured: the unit test for flagged, unflagged and empty-difference cases.' '  Follow-ups, not done: call the check where a change lands; require a new heading through' '  `athena_data::decision_links::headings`, which needs both log texts as inputs; merge the two constants. Not' '  measured: the share of newly refused readings; no reading rule changed.' > /dev/null; echo skip
